name: cache-watch
description: Watches the prompt cache: its state in the prompt footer, and a cold send held above the prompt with its price and buttons to pay, compact, start fresh or close. Fork of karanb192/cache-tax 2.3.1 (MIT). Warming uses model requests and costs tokens.

windowMinutes.title: Default keepwarm window (minutes)
windowMinutes.description: How long bare /keepwarm lasts, and how long after a turn /keepwarm always keeps the cache warm.

always.title: Keepwarm always
always.description: Keep every session warm for the default window after each turn, until /keepwarm off.

cutoffTime.title: Daily cutoff time (HH:MM, 24-hour)
cutoffTime.description: Local time after which no automatic window opens or lasts, until midnight. An explicit /keepwarm is not cut. Leave empty for no cutoff.

coldCompact.title: Compact cold sends
coldCompact.description: Adds Compact buttons to the cards, and compacts before a cold send from a remote session. Needs a compaction that is cheap on a cold cache, such as JetCompact's: the built-in summary reads the whole conversation uncached.
